title: Attention kernel signal fanout, layer-level sanity checks, and degradation-rate controller
creator: Priya Kaur
description: Goal: Reduce production regression risk from FlashAttention v2/v3 kernel swaps during prefill and decode by building a telemetry-driven kernel predictor + layer-level sanity checks and a degradation-rate controller (deg-rate controller) that can throttle or hedge kernel activation. This ticket scopes the core predictor model, signal selection, canary policy, rollback playbook, and the ops runbook for incidents.
background: Recent canaries swapped to v3 for some workloads and we observed two modes of regression: (1) sporadic layer-level failures for uncommon shape combinations (long context + odd head-splits), and (2) gradual latency/variance drift under bursty decode patterns. Existing heuristics pick kernels purely on historical throughput; we need a signal-rich predictor and a safety controller to reduce blast radius.
approach: 1) Build an in-runtime predictor that consumes compact telemetry (matrix-shape histogram, per-layer workspace pressure, batch_size, seq_len, past token decode time quantiles, recent failed-launch counts) and emits a kernel confidence score for v2 vs v3. 2) Add layer-level sanity checks: per-layer boolean gates if certain signals (workspace > threshold, head-slice sizes incompatible) are met. 3) Implement a degradation-rate controller: if error/latency drift exceeds thresholds, the controller slows v3 rollouts by probabilistic hedging (fractional offload to v2) and triggers automatic safe rollback when regression windows persist.
technical_notes:
- Predictor model: lightweight XGBoost-like ranking using recent telemetry windows (1min/5min). Persisted features are bounded-size sketches to avoid overhead.
- Signals to collect: shape_signature, aggregate_workspace_bytes, kv_cache_hit_rate, decode_token_latency_p50/p95/p99, failed_kernel_launches, tenant_priority, quantization_mode.
- Canary plan: staged tenant group sizes (0.1%, 1%, 5%) with ramp gated by p95 token-latency and failed_launch_rate.
- APIs: extant kernel selection hook will accept a (kernel_hint, confidence) pair. Add fallback path with deterministic seed to reduce non-determinism.
- Observability: add telemetry dashboards and regression alert (delta p95 > 20% over baseline for 10 minutes).
acceptance_criteria:
- Predictor is running in canary for low-risk tenants and exposes per-request kernel_confidence.
- Layer sanity gates block v3 when workspace or shape invariants are violated and fallback to v2.
- Deg-rate controller implements hedging and rollback policy and has documented thresholds in runbook.
- End-to-end tests: synthetic harness reproduces a known regression and confirms controller rolls back within configured window.
- Benchmarks: no >2% median latency overhead on non-switching workloads.
- PRs: runtime changes + telemetry pipeline changes merged and integrated with console dashboards.
